title: COSMIC Func Document
description: Functional-process design artifact migrated from cosmic-claude assets/schemas/func.json; metadata dropped (no manual-editing UX in docwright), desiredCfps added as the chain anchor copied from the upstream req artifact.

index.description: 1-based position of this function in the upstream plan functions array; must equal the upstream req artifact's index

desiredCfps.description: CFP budget copied from the upstream req artifact's desiredCfps; anchors the later tech-stage breakdown

diagrams.description: Full mermaid diagram source strings (sequence diagrams of the functional processes)

processes.description: Functional processes of this function; names must be unique within the document

name.description: Unique business-level process name (business object + action; design/technical words are rejected by rules)

description.description: What this process does for the originating user

originator.description: Who triggers this process (must differ from receiver)

origination_event.description: The triggering event of this process
